logo_override.validation_detail: HTTP 200, content-type image/png, 3635 bytes, 180x180, fully opaque; canvas pixel audit mean luminance 163 with 35% dark pixels, and rendered on white it shows Wellcome's 'W' mark as white on a solid black square, so it reads clearly on a light card

notes: The stored URL https://wellcome.org/grant-funding/schemes/early-career-awards redirects (HTTP 200 after redirect) to https://wellcome.org/research-funding/schemes/wellcome-early-career-awards, which is the current home of the Early-Career Award page. The awarding body is the Wellcome Trust, a charitable foundation, so image_kind is official_logo and not official_government. The site's own header logo is an INLINE svg - scan of wellcome.org returns no logo at all, because the header mark is inline SVG; the /icons/ directory is the only file-backed source.
